term.description: The word or phrase to look up.

en.name: Glossary
en.description: Your own terms and what they mean, for Textus AI to look up while it writes.
en.tool.look_up_term: Looks up a term in the user's own glossary: what they mean by it. Use it before explaining or rewriting a term the user may have defined.

zh.name: 术语表
zh.description: 你自己的术语和含义，写作时让 Textus AI 查。
zh.tool.look_up_term: 在用户自己的术语表里查一个词：用户用它指什么。解释或改写用户可能定义过的词之前先查。
zh.termsHint: 每行一条：术语 = 含义。
